name: getpgid
description: getpgid() retrieves the process group ID (PGID) of the specified process. If pid is zero, it returns the PGID of the calling process.

parameters.name: pid
parameters.description: The process ID for which to get the PGID. If zero, the calling process's ID is used.

return_value.success: Returns the process group ID on success
return_value.failure: Returns -1 on error, and errno is set

errors.description: pid does not match any process
